event.name: c. 2930 BC: One estimate for death of Egyptian ruler Den; dates are debated

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The century page gives c.2930 BCE as Den’s death, but gives no separate citation for that specific date and notes a general lack of citations. The biography gives c.2970 as the start of a 42-year reign; World History Encyclopedia gives c.2940 as an end of his reign, and peer-reviewed 2023 radiocarbon modeling estimates accession broadly 3104–2913 BCE (2σ), not a death date. These chronologies cannot be reconciled into a certain exact year. The -2930 one-year slot records only one proposed estimate, not proof of the date or place of death. Tomb T at Umm el-Qa’ab is a regional reference, not the death location.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Uncited approximate overview estimate; conflicting chronology; exact date unknown.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Regional reference near known tomb, not proven death or burial-event location.
